items.scope: Entscheidungstore D1–D3/D5/D6 und reproduzierbare Ist-Baseline; `docs/` ADR, Mess-, Konflikt- und Bestandsregister neu. Tatsächlichen HEAD/Arbeitsbaum, bestehende Implementierung und Tests gegen alle FR/SC nachvalidieren und vorhandene Funktionen präzise belegen; statische Teilbewertungen nicht als Nachweis übernehmen. Jede Abweichung samt Eigentümer und unveränderten Zielwerten erfassen; ADR-Review und Rückverfolgung gegen alle Specs.
D4: Zugänge, SDK-/Lizenz-/Plattform- und Hardware-Machbarkeit mit Belegen je Anbieter; `docs/` Nachweis neu. Positiver Nachweis oder konkreter blocker je Dienst, kein vorgetäuschter Erfolg.

Metadaten, migrationssichere Identität und generischer sicherer Credential-Speicher: `src/track_metadata.rs`, `src/library_store.rs`, neues `src/credentials.rs`, neue versionierte Verträge. Geheimnisse OS-geschützt speichern und Zugriff/Fehler testen; Migrations-, Neustart-, Verlust-/Deduplizierungs- und Parallelzugriffstests. Dieser gemeinsame Speicher steht vor jedem Providerzugriff bereit.

Gemeinsamer begrenzter Analyse-Scheduler: `src/audio_analyzer.rs`, `src/library.rs`, neues `src/analysis_scheduler.rs`; Fortschritt, Abbruch, Prioritäten, Schutz aktiver Wiedergabe; Last-/Recovery-/Queue-Tests.

Gemeinsame Beat-/Phrase-/Energie-/Tonartmodelle inklusive Confidence und manuellen Overrides: `src/tempo.rs`, `src/beatgrid.rs`, `src/audio_analyzer.rs`, neue Analyse- und Harmonie-Module. Versionierte Fixtures, Randfälle und Erhalt manueller Korrekturen.

Sample-genauer nichtblockierender Befehls-Scheduler: `src/controller.rs`, `src/deck_render.rs`, `src/sync_control.rs`; feste Grenzen, Ownership, Überlauf und Clock-Vertrag. Deterministische Timing-, Stress- und Threadtests.

Vier-Deck-Grundmodell und Routing schrittweise: `src/deck_render.rs`, `src/mixer_dsp.rs`, `src/output_routing.rs`, `src/controller.rs`; zwei/vier Decks isoliert, kein Abbruch spielender Decks, Routing- und Lasttests.

Audio-Taps für Deck/Master/Cue sowie begrenzte Übergabe an Encoder/Analyse: `src/render_bus.rs`, `src/cue_bus.rs`, neue Tap-Module. Signalpositions-, Queue-Überlauf-, Dropout- und Callback-Allokationsmessungen.

FR-001: System MUST check for updates automatically on application startup after a 3-second delay; FR-002: System MUST display update notifications with version number and release notes.
FR-005: System MUST allow users to manually trigger update checks by clicking the version display; FR-006: System MUST show current version number in the UI at all times.
FR-009: System MUST integrate with GitHub Releases for update hosting; FR-013: System MUST support multiple update channels (stable, beta).
FR-007: System MUST support background downloads without blocking the UI; FR-008: System MUST handle download failures with appropriate error messages.

FR-010: System MUST verify update file integrity before installation; FR-011: System MUST preserve user data during update installation; FR-012: System MUST log all update-related events for debugging.
FR-003: System MUST allow users to download updates with real-time progress display; FR-004: System MUST install downloaded updates when the application quits.

FR-014: System MUST authenticate users before allowing sync operations; FR-015: System MUST isolate data per user (no cross-user data access); Abnahme: serverseitige Zugriffe ohne gültige Identität und auf fremde Nutzerdaten werden nachweislich abgewiesen.

FR-001: System MUST sync track library metadata (title, artist, album, BPM, key, duration, file path); FR-002: System MUST sync all user playlists and playlist contents; FR-003: System MUST sync cue points for each track (hot cues with positions, colors, labels); FR-004: System MUST sync beat grid analysis data for each track.

FR-005: System MUST sync all application settings and preferences; FR-006: System MUST display real-time sync status (syncing, synced, error, offline); FR-007: System MUST support manual sync trigger via UI button; FR-008: System MUST support automatic sync on a configurable interval.

FR-009: System MUST allow selective sync by category (library, playlists, settings, cue points, beat grids); FR-010: System MUST track last sync timestamp per device; FR-011: System MUST identify each device uniquely for conflict resolution.
FR-012: System MUST implement last-write-wins conflict resolution strategy; FR-013: System MUST work offline and queue changes for next sync.
FR-016: System MUST handle sync errors gracefully with user-friendly messages; FR-017: System MUST report item counts after successful sync (e.g., "Synced 1,234 tracks").
FR-001: System MUST analyze audio files to detect beats per minute (BPM); FR-002: System MUST detect individual beat positions throughout tracks.

FR-003: System MUST calculate confidence scores for BPM detection (0-100%); FR-004: System MUST classify tempo ranges (slow: 60-90, medium: 90-120, fast: 120-160, very fast: 160+); FR-005: System MUST detect time signatures (4/4, 3/4, 6/8, etc.).
FR-006: System MUST handle tracks from 40 BPM to 200+ BPM; FR-007: System MUST correct half-time and double-time octave errors; FR-008: System MUST provide manual BPM entry option.

FR-009: System MUST implement tap tempo functionality (minimum 4 taps); FR-010: System MUST support batch analysis of multiple tracks; FR-011: System MUST display analysis progress for batch operations.
FR-012: System MUST store BPM data with track metadata; FR-013: System MUST allow manual override of detected BPM; FR-014: System MUST calculate beat interval variance for consistency measurement.

FR-015: System MUST use onset strength detection for beat finding; FR-016: System MUST apply low-pass filtering (0-200Hz) to focus on kick drums; FR-017: System MUST use histogram clustering to identify dominant tempo.
